threshold_rule: Earlier chronological group-purged calibration only; maximum calibration F1; higher cutoff breaks ties
limits: Previously inspected historical data; new comparisons are adaptive research, never fresh final accuracy.
Archived source rules and linked programme records may differ from current corrected sources.
Source identities and 30-day labels must reconcile before any alternate horizon.
All horizons require their full outcome window through the recorded source observation date.
Final-service target requires recorded complete unique stages 1..N, not independently confirmed treatment completion.
Positive windows can overlap and do not equal unique callback visit counts.
Compare horizons by business meaning and support; a higher accuracy on a rarer target does not establish better prediction.
No automatic production replacement, source modification, or prospective backfill.
pre_fit_amendment: Original feature export omits source row keys. Added exact archived population/sale/date mapping before any model fit. Candidate pool and evaluation rules unchanged.
